question: What restaurant can I find within 150 kilometers of George R. Brown School of Engineering, Houston, TX toward the west?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-95.398757 29.720135)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-95.398757 29.720135)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND amenity = 'restaurant'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
